geometry.description: Window position on screen using {+|-}X{+|-}Y format. +0X is left edge, -0X is right edge, +0Y is upper edge, -0Y is lower edge.

no_extract.description: If true, disable extraction of files from ISO filesystem to hard disk.

focus_mode.description: Keyboard focus behavior: 'click_to_focus' (mouse click required) or 'auto_focus' (follows mouse pointer).
